fullDescription: A clean, fresh messaging/chat screen: white ground, teal outgoing bubbles and soft-grey incoming, a header with avatar + call/video, a timestamp divider, a link-preview card, a typing indicator, and an input bar with a teal send button.
prompt:
## Resumo
A modern, friendly messaging / chat CONVERSATION screen: a header (back + avatar + name + 'Active now' + call / video / menu), a centered timestamp divider, incoming message bubbles (soft grey, with a small sender avatar) and outgoing bubbles (fresh teal, white text) with a 'Read' receipt, a link-preview card, a 'typing…' indicator, and a bottom input bar (+ , a rounded message field with an emoji icon, and a teal send button). Crisp and high-contrast.

## Estilo Visual
Light, clean messaging. White / very-light ground (subtle dot texture ok), near-black text. Outgoing bubbles in fresh TEAL/emerald with white text (clears contrast); incoming bubbles in soft neutral grey with ink text. Teal is the single accent (outgoing bubbles, avatar ring, send button). Rounded bubble corners with the usual tail-side flattening. Clean sans font. NOT warm-clay, NOT slop-indigo; teal is a deliberate fresh-cool choice (genuinely apt for chat).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header
Status bar; a chat header with a back chevron, a circular avatar (with an 'active' dot), the contact name + 'Active now', and call / video / overflow icons on the right.

### Timestamp divider
A small centered pill 'TODAY · 9:41 AM' separating the thread.

### Incoming bubbles
Left-aligned soft-grey bubbles with ink text, each with a small sender avatar; natural multi-line wrapping.

### Outgoing bubbles
Right-aligned fresh-teal bubbles with white text; a small right-aligned 'Read 9:42 AM' receipt under the last one.

### Link preview
A link-preview card (icon + title + domain + time) styled as an incoming attachment.

### Typing indicator
A small incoming bubble with three animated dots ('…').

### Input bar
A bottom bar: a circular '+' (attach), a rounded 'Message …' field with an emoji icon, and a circular teal send button (arrow).

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Two-tone bubbles — In vs out.
Incoming = soft grey + ink; outgoing = teal + white; rounded with tail-side corner flattening; comfortable line-height.

### Teal send button — The accent action.
A circular teal send button (paper-plane/arrow) at the end of the input bar.

## Notas Especiais
Teal is the single accent; keep incoming/outgoing contrast high. Real mobile proportions; reflow at 360/768. No warm clay, no slop-indigo.
